semiconductor_relevance: High — Kokusai Semiconductor Europe GmbH provides critical equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, including thermal batch processing and metrology solutions.
summary: Kokusai Semiconductor Europe GmbH specializes in manufacturing systems for the semiconductor industry, focusing on vertical batch furnaces and metrology solutions. Their products support key processes such as LPCVD and plasma ashing, catering to the needs of memory, IoT, power electronics, and AI chip production.
capabilities: Vertical batch furnaces for LPCVD and high-temperature applications
Plasma ashers for single wafer and batch processing
Support for wafer sizes of 150mm, 200mm, and 300mm
